title: Deploying Lightweight Input-Aware Selective Instruction Duplication in HPC Applications
problem: Silent data corruptions (SDCs) from transient hardware faults in HPC; input-dependent SDC propagation not captured by existing SID methods that use only default inputs
motivation: Modern HPC applications vulnerable to transient faults; existing selective instruction duplication (SID) approaches have poor SDC coverage on non-default inputs
method: Protego framework: vulnerability-guided input exploration to identify distinct input groups with different SID patterns; lightweight runtime feature extraction for input classification; adaptive SID deployment
key_novelty: Input-aware SID that adapts protection strategy based on runtime input characteristics without full re-profiling
contributions: Lightweight input classification for runtime SID selection
Evaluation across 10 HPC applications demonstrating coverage preservation
hardware_target: HPC systems with transient fault exposure
limitations: Evaluation limited to 10 applications; overhead of input exploration phase not detailed
